_note: STAGE A for CASE 3 (AttachedSBLI). Identical in every respect to
sweep_coarse_v1 except the p_c range, which is moved onto case 3's own
Case 3 runs with the wedge installed, so the cavity pressure is much
higher than cases 1-2: nominal 68.88 kPa, not ~50.4 kPa. Sweeping
48.5-55.0 kPa here would run 650 points roughly 14 kPa away from the
condition the experiment was actually at, and could not answer which
regime the experiment is in. qs_preflight now refuses a study whose box
does not contain the case nominal, which is what caught this.
Box: 64.0-74.0 kPa is about +/-9 sigma of the 529 Pa cavity-pressure
error either side of 68.88 kPa, and it overlaps the range the original
unheated case-3 sweep used (55.2-74.5 kPa) where the boundary was found.
26 x 25 = 650 points at 3 s, comparable in cost to the other two cases.
